## Overview

Completed as my **Master's Thesis in Computer Science** at the **University of Trento** (defended March 19, 2026; final degree grade: **110/110 *cum laude***).

## Focus

- Investigates **shape-aware methods for heart rate estimation**, bridging signal processing, geometric/morphological representations, and data-driven modelling.
- Forms part of my broader technical background in integrating **physiological sensors** and **AI-based tools** for health-oriented interactive systems.
